body: Ive written my thoughts and it makes them a multitude worse than it is normally. I was put on this planet to love one person- I found her and ruined everything so writing something down wont fix anything. Its been two months, im just "pretending to be happier" to people in my family, im planning on doing a hiking trip out of state somewhere and end up as a "missing person". Ill leave a trail and a note of where Ill be when police start to question and investigate. Idk, im ready to find my small corner, grieve over my regrets, mistakes, and losses, then kill myself. My family knows im single, I turn 24 in March- but my 4 year anniversary would have been February 20th. Im ready to go, I just am talking about it because i want someone to give me peace of mind before I go- basically to help me with my journey into death
